title: (5, 5) as 2(1, 2) + (3, 1)
caption: Walk twice along (1, 2), then once along (3, 1): you arrive at (5, 5). The coefficients 2 and 1 are how many steps of each vector.
alt: A grid with a vector from the origin to (2, 4), a vector from (2, 4) to (5, 5), and their sum from the origin to (5, 5).
description: Two steps of (1, 2) from the origin reach (2, 4).
From there one step of (3, 1) reaches (5, 5).
The sum 2(1, 2) + (3, 1) = (5, 5) is the vector from the origin straight to (5, 5).
